sources.title: Create Image Captioning Models | Google Skills
sources.snippet: This course teaches you how to create an image captioning model by using deep learning. You learn about the different components of an image captioning model, such as the encoder and decoder, and how to train and evaluate your model.

sources.title: Image Captioning Evaluation in the Age of Multimodal LLMs: Challenges ...
sources.snippet: The evaluation of machine-generated image captions is a complex and evolving challenge. With the advent of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), image captioning has become a core task, increasing the need for robust and reliable evaluation metrics.
